review_candidates.title: HIL Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) Validation Engineer to support the development, integration, testing, and validation of automotive embedded systems. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience developing and executing HIL test cases, configuring HIL test benches, debugging ECU/software issues, and working with automotive communication protocols and simulation environments. Key Responsibilities Develop, execute, and maintain HIL validation test cases for automotive ECUs and embedded systems. Configure and operate HIL test benches for ECU integration and system-level validation. Develop test scenarios covering normal operation, fault conditions, boundary conditions, and failure modes. Perform automated and manual testing of embedded automotive software. Integrate ECUs with HIL systems and validate hardware/software interfaces. Analyze test results, identify failures, and perform detailed root-cause analysis. Debug ECU communication, software, hardware, and integration issues. Work with CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, and UDS communication protocols. Develop and maintain simulation models for sensors, actuators, vehicle systems, and network communication. Validate ECU behavior under various operating and fault conditions. Create test reports, defect reports, test documentation, and validation summaries. Collaborate with software, controls, systems, hardware, and calibration teams. Support regression testing and continuous integration/continuous testing activities. Participate in requirements reviews and ensure test coverage against system/software requirements. Support SIL, MIL, and HIL validation activities where applicable. Troubleshoot issues using CAN logs, trace data, diagnostic tools, and HIL system measurements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field . 3+ years of experience in automotive embedded testing/validation . Hands-on experience with HIL testing and validation . Strong understanding of ECU testing and embedded software validation. Experience with CAN/CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, and UDS . Experience developing test cases, test procedures, and validation plans. Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills. Experience working with embedded systems and automotive ECUs. Programming/scripting experience with Python, CAPL, C/C++, MATLAB, or similar . Ability to analyze CAN/network traces and diagnostic communication. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with dSPACE, Vector, NI, ETAS, or similar HIL platforms . Experience with dSPACE SCALEXIO, MicroAutoBox, ControlDesk, AutomationDesk , or similar tools. Experience with Vector CANoe/CANalyzer . Experience with MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow . Experience with CAPL scripting . Knowledge of AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive . Experience with UDS diagnostics (ISO 14229) . Knowledge of J1939 and automotive Ethernet. Experience with SIL/MIL/HIL testing methodologies . Experience testing ADAS, powertrain, body, chassis, EV, battery, or vehicle control systems . Knowledge of requirements traceability and test management tools such as DOORS, Polarion, Jira, or similar. Experience with automated test frameworks and CI/CD . Familiarity with functional safety standards such as ISO 26262 .

We are looking for a Global Director of Brand Events to elevate our global event ecosystem, shaping the brand activation strategy, enabling tools and frameworks for scale, and developing innovative formats and partnerships across key markets. We are looking for someone with a strong entrepreneurial spirit who takes ownership, brings new ideas forward, and thrives in building and evolving a global function. The Brand Events team plays a critical role in bringing our community together and translating On’s mission into meaningful, memorable experiences around the world. Your mission Set the global strategic vision for brand activations and events at On Develop immersive event formats aligned with global campaigns and Go-To-Market initiatives Identify and implement tools and technologies to elevate event experiences and enable scale Source, negotiate, and manage partnerships with relevant organizations to drive event impact and success Promote and amplify the full range of On’s brand activations across channels and markets Define global event brand standards and ensure consistent execution across all touchpoints Analyze event performance and data to drive continuous improvement and learning Enable and support markets to execute events in line with global brand guidelines Lead the development of communication frameworks across pre-, during-, and post-event moments Grow and strengthen On’s global community and fan base through impactful activations Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global team of brand activation and event experts Your story 10+ years of experience leading and delivering global events, with a proven track record of impactful brand activations 7+ years of experience managing and developing high-performing teams Ideally, experience within a global sportswear, athletic, or performance brand, with a strong understanding of community-driven marketing Experience working in a creative agency environment (in-house or external), with a strong creative and solution-oriented mindset Deep expertise across physical, digital, and hybrid event formats at global scale Strong leadership skills, with experience operating in highly matrixed, international organizations Entrepreneurial, proactive, and driven to innovate, optimize, and build new approaches Excellent communicator with an inspiring, collaborative, and positive leadership style Meet the team Your team shapes and delivers On’s global brand events—from campaign launches and athlete moments to community activations and key brand experiences. They ensure every event reflects our brand, supports our strategic priorities, and creates meaningful connections with our community. The team is structured across four core global streams: Event Strategy & Concept Development, Event Management, Event Operations, and Event Communications, and works in close partnership with our regional event teams to ensure strong and consistent execution worldwide. What We Offer On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.
